_comment: buddy-scheduler JSON output schema. Emitted to stdout on every execution path.

_always_present.success: boolean — true if a valid pairing was produced (MIP or fallback)
_always_present.timestamp: string — ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of run completion
_always_present.pairs: array of [string, string] — member pairs; empty on failure
_always_present.sitting_out: string|null — name of sit-out member (odd teams); null otherwise
_always_present.optimization_score: number — total weighted penalty; 0.0 on failure
_always_present.solve_time: number — wall-clock seconds for the full run
_always_present.history_updated: boolean — true if history store was modified this run

_conditionally_present.solver_gap: number — achieved MIP gap fraction; present only for direct MIP solutions
_conditionally_present.peak_memory_mb: number — peak RSS memory in MB; present when psutil available
_conditionally_present.memory_delta_mb: number — memory increase from start to peak; present when psutil available
_conditionally_present.inactive_members: array of string — names of inactive members excluded from pairing; omitted if empty
_conditionally_present.avoidance_conflicts: array of string — human-readable conflict descriptions; present only when success=false due to infeasible hard constraints
_conditionally_present.error: string — error message; present only on unexpected exception

_solver_profile_encoding.note: When --solver-profile adaptive is used, the resolved profile name is emitted, not "adaptive"
